Statutory Master Plan for Delhi notified on 20.08.2026 under Section 11A, DD Act 1957

Spatial Development Strategy & Policies for Delhi 2047

MPD-2047 plans for a projected population of 3.2 Crore (32 million) with 40 lakh new dwelling units. It pivots Delhi from unconstrained outward sprawl to disciplined compact growth through Transit-Oriented Development (TOD) along 695 km of Metro, High Density Corridors (HDC) along the 75 km UER-II, Land Pooling across 200 sq. km, and net-zero ecological stewardship of the 7,784 Ha Ridge and River Yamuna.

Land Pooling (200 sq. km, 60:40 share, FAR 200) TOD Influence Zones (500m buffer, FAR 400-500) HDC Corridors (UER-II 250m, FAR 400) Low Density Areas (47 Border Villages, 50% Green)

Chapter 4 Gazette Provisions

Spatial Development Policies (Map 4 Hub)

Map 4 defines the statutory spatial restructuring of Delhi across 6 core pillars: Land Pooling, Transit Oriented Development, High Density Corridors, Low Density Areas, Brownfield Regeneration, and Special Heritage Areas.

Clause 4.1 ~200 sq. km

Land Pooling Policy

Implemented across Zones K-I, L, N, P-II, J (part), and P-I. Operates on a 60:40 Land Sharing model where pooled land is assembled into modern townships.

Land Sharing: 60% Owner : 40% DDA
Return Mix: 53% Res, 5% Comm, 2% PSP
Net FAR: FAR 200 on Res plots
Min Scheme Area: 20 Hectares (70% consent)
Clause 4.2 ~200 sq. km

Transit-Oriented Development (TOD)

Covers 500m influence zones along Metro corridors and 500m radius around RRTS/Railway hubs to promote compact, walkable, transit-centric high-density living.

Base / Max FAR: Base 400 / Max 500
Mandatory Mix: Min 65% Res, 10% Comm
Small Format: Min 50% DU area ≤60 sqm
Parking Norm: 1 ECS / 100 sqm (Reduced)
Clause 4.3 ~20 sq. km

High Density Corridor (HDC)

Designated 250m depth on either side of UER-II (Urban Extension Road-II) across Zones P-I, P-II, N, M, K-I, and K-II for world-class mixed use.

Corridor Depth: 250m from ROW edge
Surrender Norm: 50% Plot Surrender (min 8k sqm)
Permissible FAR: FAR 400 (Mixed) / 120 (Logistics)
Affordable Housing: Min 20% FAR (≤60 sqm)
Clause 4.4 ~150 sq. km

Low Density Area (LDA)

Depth of 1 peripheral revenue village along NCT border (47 villages, Annexure 17a) + 23 declared LDRA villages (Annexure 17b).

Min Plot Area: 10,000 sqm (1 Hectare)
Green Mandate: Min 50% Green (30% Canopy)
Farmhouse FAR: FAR 10 / Max Height 10m (G+1)
Net-Zero Water: 100% on-site STP & reuse
Clause 4.5 & 4.6 Citywide

Urban Regeneration & Slum ISR

Upgradation of 1,797 Unauthorised Colonies, Urban Villages, 25 industrial clusters, and In-situ Slum Rehabilitation (ISR) on PPP basis.

Slum ISR Formula: 40% Rehab : 60% Remunerative
ISR FAR: FAR 500 on both components
Unauthorised Colonies: FAR 350 + Amenities FAR (20-50)
Group Housing Renewal: 1.5x Base FAR (30+ yr old)
Clause 4.7 Historic Core

Special Areas & Heritage TDR

Shahjahanabad (Walled City), Karol Bagh, Paharganj, and Sadar Bazar. Introduces Heritage Transferable Development Rights (TDR).

Heritage TDR Incentive: FAR Incentive 50
Pedestrianization: Non-motorised historic spine
Night-time Economy: 24x7 cultural dining & retail
Consolidation Hubs: Freight transfer at peripheries

Statutory Territorial Divisions (Map 2)

17 Planning Zones Matrix (Zones A through P)

Delhi NCT is divided into 17 statutory planning zones covering 1,483 sq. km. Each zone carries specific character typologies, applicable FAR, and anchor megaprojects.
